text:
sam_release: Heads-up: deploybot blocked canary publish to eu-west during the 18:00 release window — deploybot reports manifest digest != pushed image digest for ecr://redwood-prod/frontend:release-20260321. Anyone around?

deploybot: [auto] publish blocked for ecr://redwood-prod/frontend:release-20260321
reason: manifest_digest=sha256:aaa111... vs pushed_layer_digest=sha256:bbb222...
action: hold and notify channel.

alex_dev: Ugh. I saw a flaky CI step earlier that trimmed metadata. Pasting the last CI publish log:
```
+ aws ecr put-image --repository-name frontend --image-manifest file://manifest.json
Response: success
+ cosign attest --key kms://projects/... --payload manifest.json
Attestation: OK
+ echo "push digest: sha256:bbb222..."
```
But the registry's manifest lists sha256:aaa111... (from the builder).

cheng_platform: @alex_dev can you confirm which commit/sha the builder used vs the sidecar that generated manifest.json? Could be async republish from the mirror job.

alex_dev: checking now. Builder shows commit 7f3c2a3, sidecar used commit 7f3c2a3 as well. Time stamps slightly off (builder 17:58, sidecar 17:59). The republish worker retried at 18:05 and might have re-calculated manifest layers.

lisa_sre: For the release window decision: do we pin the canary to previous stable digest or retag the newer pushed digest and continue? Previous stable is ecr://redwood-prod/frontend@sha256:ccc333...

sam_release: Can we do a quick verification that the content actually differs or it's just metadata ordering? If it's ordering we can accept a republished manifest that canonicalizes order. If layer checksums differ, that's a true content mismatch and we should rollback.

alex_dev: Running quick `skopeo inspect` on both manifests now. Output:
```
skopeo inspect docker://ecr.amazonaws.com/redwood-prod/frontend:release-20260321 --raw | jq -r '.config.digest'
# returns sha256:bbb222...
skopeo inspect docker://ecr.amazonaws.com/redwood-prod/frontend@sha256:aaa111... --raw | jq -r '.config.digest'
# returns sha256:aaa111...
```
These are different — looks like two different image blobs.

cheng_platform: That suggests a partial republish created a different image. Any idea which one was pushed to EU vs US? We need region-level pinning. deploybot, can you show which region the blocked publish targeted?

deploybot: publish target: eu-west-1 mirror. blocked_region: eu-west-1. origin_push_region: us-east-1 (timestamp 2026-03-21T17:58:41Z).

lisa_sre: Given it's a real content diff, I'm leaning to pin the canary to the last known-good digest `sha256:ccc333...` for the window and open an incident to investigate the republish worker. We should avoid doing a new retag in the middle of the release window unless absolutely necessary.

sam_release: Agreed. Impact: canary won't get the new code; rollout to prod will be delayed ~30m. We should update release notes and notify PMs.

alex_dev: I'll trigger a manual rollback of the canary route to sha256:ccc333... and also dump the builder artifacts for postmortem. Command I'll run: `deployctl tag --region eu-west-1 frontend@sha256:ccc333... release-20260321-canary` then notify deploybot to resume.

cheng_platform: Also please capture the replication logs between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for the mirror queue (runbook: infra/mirror-replication/docs).

deploybot: manual tag requested by alex_dev — queuing. Waiting for confirmation.

alex_dev: done. Pushed manual tag. Verified `skopeo inspect` now returns config.digest sha256:ccc333... for the canary tag in eu-west-1.

lisa_sre: OK hold released for the release window. Sam, please update release Slack #release-notes and add note about delayed canary + follow-up investigation.

sam_release: Will do. Drafting message: "Canary publish for frontend:release-20260321 was held due to cross-region image digest mismatch. Canary pinned to last-known-good digest sha256:ccc333... while we investigate republish worker. Impact: no canary rollout for ~30m, no prod rollouts. PMs notified." @cheng_platform can you add the mirror logs to the incident ticket?

cheng_platform: On it. I'll create INC-2026-234 and attach logs and timeline. Also will add retention point for republish worker to avoid double-push race.

alex_dev: Follow-up tasks for postmortem: 1) ensure republish worker verifies artifact checksums before repush 2) add a manifest canonicalization step so ordering differences don't cause false mismatches 3) a deploybot flag to prefer explicit digest pinning during release windows.

lisa_sre: Thumbs-up. :thumbsup: Good call pinning instead of retagging mid-window.

sam_release: All set here. Closing thread once INC ticket is created. Thanks everyone.

deploybot: incident created INC-2026-234 by cheng_platform. Attachments: mirror_queue_* logs.

sam_release: Closing the hold. We'll resume normal publish after postmortem and a minor deploybot rule update.
